BINARY_VS_CONTINUOUS.DGP_LINEAR: P(y) = 0.5 + beta * z (z = standardized score), with beta chosen so that the implied mean E - S rate gap equals delta; clipped to [0.01, 0.99], clipped share reported
BINARY_VS_CONTINUOUS.READING: The continuous score improves efficiency materially only if it beats the binary test under DGP_LINEAR without losing much under DGP_STEP. Reported, not used for the primary verdict.
BINARY_VS_CONTINUOUS.TESTS: binary E coefficient vs continuous z slope, each in its own OLS with symbol FE, CR1 by week

CANDIDATE_STATES.CONCEPT: Price makes a new local low (the detector requires low_i < low_j after a >= 3 ATR decline). Aggressive selling weakens relative to the prior downswing or a local baseline. Open interest does not expand. Support is present. No oscillator input.
CANDIDATE_STATES.DIVERGENCE_FLAGS: RSI/MACD/CVD families and DIVERGENCE are descriptive cross-tabulations only, never in an inclusion rule
CANDIDATE_STATES.PIT: Every input ends at or before the close of pivot bar i, three bars before T. A truncation audit recomputes the inputs on bars and OI truncated at T: 30 episodes per symbol must be identical.
CANDIDATE_STATES.SELECTION: Both variants are reported in full. No variant is selected by outcome performance. A later choice may use only counts, dependence and concept.
CANDIDATE_STATES.UNDEFINED: A missing OI as-of value or zero volume makes that variant's state undefined. The episode is excluded from that variant's E/S and counted.

SE_BASELINE.FLOW_INPUT: APPROACH_FLOW_EXCESS = share(i-23..i) - median over k in [i-696, i-24] of share(k-23..k); every bar lies in i-719..i
SE_BASELINE.JUSTIFICATION: Windows reuse the frozen SEED-0001 constants FLOW_BARS = 24 and WARMUP_BARS = 720, which the detector already guarantees to be complete. The thresholds are the median (flow) and the no-change point (OI). No pivot-spacing dependence.
SE_BASELINE.OI_INPUT: APPROACH_OI_CHANGE = OI(close of bar i) / OI(close of bar i - 24h) - 1

SE_LEG.FLOW_INPUT: LEG_FLOW_CHANGE = share(j+1..i) - share(max(j-(i-j)+1, 0)..j), where share(window) = sum(2*taker_buy - volume) / sum(volume) over 1h bars
SE_LEG.JUSTIFICATION: Both thresholds are the no-change point, not chosen from data. The first-leg window has the same length as the second leg. This is the state pre-specified as DEEPER_STATE_FLOW_OI in the full-history design frozen before any 2025+ byte (c122040). Its exploratory association is not used.
SE_LEG.OI_INPUT: LEG_OI_CHANGE = OI(close of bar i) / OI(close of bar j) - 1, using 5m metrics available at create_time + 5 min, stale after 30 min

CONTINUOUS_SCORE.CONSTANTS: per-symbol median and MAD over that variant's defined support episodes on the exposed surface; feature values only; frozen in the result for any future use
CONTINUOUS_SCORE.DEFINITION: SCORE_<variant> = mean over its two components of clip((sign * (x - median_symbol)) / (1.4826 * MAD_symbol), -3, 3). The components are the flow input (sign +1) and the OI input (sign -1).
CONTINUOUS_SCORE.RESEARCHER_DEGREES_OF_FREEDOM: one transformation per variant, fixed here: no component, weight, clip or scaling choice is left open

PROFILES.BASE: one probit shock per UTC date shared by all symbols and both states, latent ICC 0.25 (V0/V1 BASE)
PROFILES.COLLAPSED: one unit per (UTC date, state) with the BASE shock (diagnostic lower bound)
PROFILES.EMPIRICAL: probit week, date and within-symbol-chain components calibrated to state-blind outcome pair correlations
PROFILES.EMPIRICAL_UPPER: the same calibration at the 95th week-bootstrap percentile of each pair-class correlation
PROFILES.STRESS: one probit shock per (UTC date, state), latent ICC 0.50 (V0/V1 STRESS); the verdict gate

STATE_BLIND_OUTCOME_CALIBRATION.INPUT: an outcome vector with symbol, decision time and week only; no candidate state is ever passed
STATE_BLIND_OUTCOME_CALIBRATION.LINK: rho = sin(pi * phi / 2); week = rho_W; date = rho_D - rho_W; chain = rho_C - rho_W, each floored at 0; tau^2 = rho / (1 - sum rho)
STATE_BLIND_OUTCOME_CALIBRATION.OUTCOMES: Y1_48H of support episodes inside the frozen DISCOVERY and VALIDATION slices only. These were already opened by DIVERGENCE_FULL_HISTORY_RESEARCH_V0; no gap-day outcome is opened.
STATE_BLIND_OUTCOME_CALIBRATION.PAIR_CLASSES: same week/other date/other symbol (W); same date/other symbol (D); same symbol 48h chain/other date/same week (C)

EFFECTS.GRID: 0.010 .. 0.150 step 0.005 (MDE80 = first grid point with power >= 0.80; analytic MDE80 = 2.8016 * null SD also reported)

ESTIMAND.NO_OUTCOME_CONTRAST: No E-versus-S outcome statistic is computed on any surface in this unit
ESTIMAND.PLANNING_MODEL: OLS/LPM of the outcome on the E indicator plus symbol fixed effects; CR1 by panel-wide UTC week; t(G - 1); two-sided 0.05 with a positive estimate required
ESTIMAND.PLANNING_OUTCOME: Y1_48H: +1R before -1R within 48h under the SEED-0001 bracket
ESTIMAND.PRIMARY: E - S (conditional on support, does the exhaustion state add value?)

KIND: FEASIBILITY_ONLY. A new research object; not a continuation or rescue of SEED-0001 and not a re-analysis of the divergence result. No SEED is created.
MOTIVATION_NOT_EVIDENCE: An exploratory pooled observation of about +4 pp (DEEPER_STATE_FLOW_OI, DIVERGENCE_FULL_HISTORY_RESEARCH_V0 stage 2) on already-opened data. It is not prior confirmatory evidence and is not used here.

POPULATION.DETECTOR: SEED0001_DETECTOR_V1, unchanged; the E1-safe scoped guard substitution of DIVERGENCE_FULL_HISTORY_RESEARCH_V0 is reused
POPULATION.EPISODES: support episodes (SUPPORT = True, arms A and B) with decision time in [2023-01-01, 2026-08-11], including the 2024-12-28..2025-01-01 gap days, which are exposed on both sides
POPULATION.INTEGRITY: Discovery-window episodes must reproduce the V0 per-symbol digests. Validation-window episode ids must reproduce DIVERGENCE_FULL_HISTORY_RESEARCH_V0 VALIDATION_EPISODES.csv.
POPULATION.SUPPORT_DEFINITION: unchanged SEED-0001 book support: in one of hours i+1..i+3 the bid5/ask5 imbalance is > 0 and >= its trailing 720h P80

PROHIBITED: selecting a variant or a score transformation by outcome
changing the detector, support rule, panel, windows or thresholds after counts
putting divergence flags in an inclusion rule
presenting the exposed surface as validation

PROJECTION.METHOD: Weeks for 80% power = W_ref * (2.8016 * SD / mean estimate)^2, from the simulation at each effect on the exposed layout (W_ref = calendar weeks spanned). Each projection <= 520 weeks is confirmed by direct simulation on a prospective stand-in that cycles the exposed weeks, rounded up to 4 weeks.
PROJECTION.PROSPECTIVE_ONLY: Confirmation needs prospective data alone; the exposed surface cannot contribute confirmatory information.

QUESTION: Within an already-present support state, does a pre-specified state of weakening selling pressure and non-expanding open interest carry useful information about subsequent reversal/trading outcomes, independently of classical oscillator divergence?
RSI_GRADIENT_SUPPORT_CANDIDATE: Recorded separately in the owner decision V3. Not evaluated, not combined, not primary.

SURFACE.CLEAN_CONFIRMATION_SURFACE: prospective data after a new, separately authorized freeze; no other protected source is identified
SURFACE.E1_ROUTES_CLOSED: Detector windows, feature lookbacks, the 720h book and flow baselines and the OI windows all end at or before the decision time (<= 2026-08-11). The only forward read is the 48h state-blind outcome for dependence calibration (<= 2026-08-13). Loaders assert the 2026-08-15 read horizon. No auxiliary join reads later bytes. No download is made: the verified local archive of DIVERGENCE_FULL_HISTORY_RESEARCH_V0 is reused.
SURFACE.STATUS: PREVIOUSLY EXPOSED: discovery for this hypothesis (detector construction, counts, dependence, feasibility, descriptive mechanism). Never presented as pristine validation.

VERDICT_RULE.FEASIBLE_FOR_PREREGISTRATION: some variant reaches 80% power at 5 pp under STRESS within REALISTIC_HORIZON_WEEKS of prospective data
VERDICT_RULE.FOUR_PP: reported beside 5 pp; the decision line is 5 pp
VERDICT_RULE.HORIZON_JUSTIFICATION: the length of the frozen SEED-0001 prospective leg (2026-10-05 .. 2028-10-05)
VERDICT_RULE.INFERENCE_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT: no variant has >= 30 E episodes in >= 30 week clusters on the exposed surface
VERDICT_RULE.INFORMATIONALLY_WEAK / FEASIBLE_ONLY_UND: not under STRESS, but under BASE or EMPIRICAL within the horizon
